Subject: California Public Records Request :: W013609-100926
Body:
RE: PUBLIC RECORDS REQUEST of October 09, 2026, Reference # W013609-100926
 
Dear Brian C,
 
The City received the following records request from you on October 09, 2026.
 
Under the California Public Records Act, I request records concerning case number R3-23-0055.

As you are aware, the Department's October 9, 2026 response to request W013534-092926 produced the Flock audit record for search ID e3ff26d0-8f26-43d6-8e73-7c70b723b665 (04/09/2024, 07:44:34 PM UTC, 428 networks searched) and withheld its reason field under Gov. Code § 7923.600. Case number R3-23-0055 is associated with that search.

Please provide the following, for January 1, 2023 through the date of this request:

1. The Flock audit record of every search conducted under the Department's Flock account in which R3-23-0055 appears in the reason or Case # field, in any capitalization or spacing, including every field of each record: search ID, date and time, user, networks searched, time frame, license plate, reason, Case #, filters, and search type. I'd ask for these in the electronic format in which the Department holds them, such as the Flock organization-audit .csv or .xlsx export (Gov. Code § 7922.570). Civil Code § 1798.90.52(a) provides that an ALPR operator that accesses ALPR information shall "Maintain a record of that access. At a minimum, the record shall include all of the following: (1) The date and time the information is accessed. ... (4) The purpose for accessing the information." The Department produced one such record under W013534-092926, so a "no responsive records" response to this item would conflict with that production.

2. All other Department records that contain or refer to case number R3-23-0055, including: any CAD incident, RMS entry, incident report, case report, or case-management record; any record of a request for, approval of, or assignment of a search or other work under that number, from any person or agency; any record of ALPR results (plate reads, images, locations, or reports) provided to any person or entity outside the Department under that number, including any Flock share, export, or download and its event-log entries; and any email, text message, or chat or messaging-app message, on City accounts or devices or on any personal account or device used to conduct City business (City of San Jose v. Superior Court (2017) 2 Cal.5th 608). For the email and messaging search, I'd ask that "R3-23-0055" and its forms without hyphens or spaces (for example "R3230055") be used as search terms, including in the accounts of each user recorded for a search in item 1.

If any portion of these records is withheld, I'd ask that it be marked in place, field by field, with the exemption relied on for that portion, so the remainder can be released (Gov. Code § § 7922.525(b), 7922.540). If the Department's position is that a responsive record is held by another agency rather than the City, please say so for that record.

This request concerns one case number. It is separate from W013534-092926 and from any other pending request, including any rolling production of monthly audit logs, and I'd ask that it be handled on its own.

Thank you,

Brian

The City has completed its response to your request and now considers this record request
W013609-100926  closed.
 
If you have any questions, please contact me using the below contact information.
 

Sincerely,
